item.title: North Carolina, Naturally: Possums
item.description:
In this episode of North Carolina, Naturally, Dr. Eleanor Spicer Rice meets Peaches, a rescued possum at the Piedmont Wildlife Center. While these native marsupials often get a bad rap, they are actually unassuming superheroes that prowl our neighborhoods for insects, venomous snakes, and roadkill, cleaning up our yards and streets under the cover of darkness.
